summary:
Plan for w163 (R3-F1): an integrate round that ends DONE leaves its stage directory uncommitted, and the next work run is refused under r46.
The fix: on DONE, the integrate round commits its stage directory and log.jsonl after the merge (scripts/supervise_rounds.py Rounds.round). start_initiative's commit stays before the session, as the r84 scenario at :1056 pins.
The file set adds a Then 'i1 is started' in tests/scenarios/supervision_rounds_steps.py, because no step has that text today.
Tests broken: none. D2, D3 and the dropped questions of an integrate round are left as open cases, not taken.
Blocked on one thing: the four accepted scenarios already pass, so nothing is red. The failing case is the findings file's keep-as-test @r84 scenario, which is not yet in features/supervision.feature. The planner cannot add it, and the work-item says to ask.
questions: Who puts the failing case into features/supervision.feature? The case is branch review 3's keep-as-test @r84 scenario 'an integrate round that ends leaves nothing uncommitted and blocks no later `work run`'. None of the four accepted scenarios is red today. Reading A: a formulation commit adds it, as e3fbf0b did for w162, before implementation. The person then sees a pinned scenario: after a DONE integrate round, `.shop/work/` is clean, i1 is started, and a second `work run i1` exits 0. That scenario is red on base. Reading B: the implementer adds the scenario as part of w163. The person sees the same behaviour, but a work-item commit changes features/, which branch reviews grade Critical. Reading C: no new scenario. The fix lands with no scenario that pins it. The person sees the r46 refusal go away, but no test keeps it from coming back.
